quote: Whenever an illuminated flashing red or yellow signal is used in conjunction with an official traffic-control device, it shall require obedience by vehicular traffic as follows: When a yellow lens is illuminated with rapid intermittent flashes, drivers of vehicles may proceed past such signal and through the intersection or other hazardous location only with caution.

activation.condition: A rapidly flashing illuminated yellow lens is used with an official traffic-control device at an intersection or other hazardous location.

obligation.description: A driver may pass the light and traverse the intersection or other hazardous location only with caution.

timing.description: Observe original-frame lamp state and driver approach and traversal throughout the hazardous location.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The law supplies no numerical flash frequency; 2 Hz is a source-capture engineering setting.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: illuminated yellow lens used with an official traffic-control device
judgment_calls_needed.note: Native Yellow/Off state does not prove lens pixels or official authority.
Measured motion and crossing context do not set a legal caution cutoff.

parameter_refs.name: target_speed_mps
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: positive engineering approach speed in m/s
